title: Northbeam TechWorks Circle Benefit Desk: Service Credit Available on a Membership
content:
The credit a Northbeam Circle Membership makes available against the charges left on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is read from the membership as it stands on the profile.

## The reading

- Where no Circle membership stands active on the profile, nothing of a membership's credit is available to set against what is left.
- Where a Circle membership stands active on the profile and its unspent benefit credit is below the service visit credit its tier grants, that unspent benefit credit is the credit available instead.
- Where neither of those situations holds, the credit available is the service visit credit the tier grants.

Where no Circle membership stands active on the profile, the tier figures a membership would have supplied — its service visit credit, its unspent credit and the redemptions its tier allows in a year — are all taken as nothing.

A Circle membership that does not stand active on the profile, whether it sits in grace with dues unpaid or has lapsed altogether, gives neither the discount nor the credit on this job, and the charge stands in full.

## The comparison the middle reading turns on

| The membership on the profile | Its unspent benefit credit against the service visit credit its tier grants | The credit available |
| --- | --- | --- |
| none standing active | — | nothing |
| standing active | below it | the unspent benefit credit standing on the membership |
| standing active | equal to it or above it | the service visit credit the tier grants |

The comparison is a strict one: an unspent balance equal to the service visit credit the tier grants is not below it, so the figure available is the tier's own service visit credit.

## Illustrations on hypothetical profiles

*The balances and the tier below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any membership on file.*

**No membership standing active.** Nothing is available, and the tier figures a membership would have supplied are taken as nothing.

**An active membership with a larger balance.** The membership stands active on Circle Total Household Annual, whose tier grants a service visit credit of 60.00 USD, and its unspent benefit credit stands at 138.50 USD. The balance is not below the tier figure, so 60.00 USD is available.

**An active membership whose balance exactly matches.** The unspent balance stands at 60.00 USD. The balance is not below the tier figure, so 60.00 USD is available.

**An active membership with a smaller balance.** The unspent balance stands at 41.20 USD, below the 60.00 USD the tier grants, so 41.20 USD is available.
